change.dedsafio3.medusa_osea.name: Bone Medusa
change.dedsafio3.medusa_osea.desc: A new creature has been seen on Gleba, the Organic Planet: Bone Medusa. A creature with unique abilities. change.dedsafio3.cerebro_rojo.name: Red Brain
change.dedsafio3.cerebro_rojo.desc: A new creature has been seen on Gleba, the Organic Planet: Red Brain. It leaps onto your head, blinding you and draining your life until you die.
